Name: The Sword of Damocles
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
The most powerful weapon ever constructed on terrestrial soil. The Sword of Damocles was built in a manner similar to a massive framebilt by Copehtor with the aid of the other Eidolons, based on visions the One with Chaos saw when gazing into another universe. It is conceptually patterned after the oddities he witnessed when peering at, or perhaps through, the Truth. It was originally intended to house the Eidolons’ essence by absorbing ambient eidomantic radiation, which it would use as a power source to fight the Grand Primaries. The Sword of Damocles was never properly deployed, however; instead, these principles were applied to later the creation of the primal gemstones.

During the War in One Moment, the Sword of Damocles was completed by Copehtor so it could be used against the Eidolons who opposed Mnemosyne, but foreknowledge about the weapon’s existence allowed Vestias to prepare for it, and using Lycrothemia’s Lunar Devastation, the Sword of Damocles was blasted back into inoperability. It used its astral transmission drive to move itself and its supporting DGR units back to the Cauldron before they could be entirely destroyed, where they crashed and lay inoperable. The remaining power from the assault destroyed thousands of square kilometers of what we now know as High Wave, forming the islands there. For their protection, the Sword of Damocles’ crew (including its operator and navigator) were ejected before transmission. The nephilim and framebilt recovered it in the Cauldron, however, where it was repaired in secret by forces that resisted Vestias’ control.

The Sword of Damocles’ true capabilities have never been properly tested, but the Eidolons consider it to be on the same level of power as the Grand Primaries, and Vestias had the nephilim of the Cauldron keep a close watch over it. When it was discovered that it had been repaired, Vestias created and dispatched Altrum Aurecavium to its repair site to destroy any rebellious nephilim and framebilt there, then froze the site permanently to prevent it from ever awakening. This resulted in the area being renamed the White Steel Grave, and approaching it was considered taboo by all those who do not carry permission from the Eidolons.

**Strange Materials.** The Sword of Damocles is made almost entirely of thesite, mined from the Cauldron during the early days of research into eidomantic radiation. Its design would have allowed it to be the original perfected eidomantic resonator, a function later given to Lycrothemia. Its design took over half of the thesite left behind by the cosmic teardrop, making it the most powerful constellationary to exist. Due to this, Vestias has opted not to destroy it; her own nature as a lover of secrets and a believer that power is only as dangerous as whomever uses (or misuses) it leaves her feeling it may one day have a use, and would lament the loss of such otherworldly technology.

**Absolute Directives.** The Sword of Damocles was constructed to protect the world from hostile alien invaders - the Grand Primaries - and then later reprogrammed to sabotage Vestias, who Copehtor considered the greatest threat to Mnemosyne among the Eidolons. It has a sense of will and desires purpose, which the Sword of Damocles follows as if second nature. Due to its orders to sabotage Vestias and its previous encounter with Lycrothemia’s Lunar Devastation, it sees the destruction of the offending moon as its most obvious objective. It would seek to destroy the moon using its godfall cannon, then itself become the core of the Eidomantic Web as it was intended so it could strong-arm Vestias into an encounter on its own terms.

For the purposes of this, if the Sword accelerates using its Mach Boost to propel itself from the edge of Somnus Domina’s atmosphere, it can move up to 1,296,000 feet/hour (accounting for Legendary actions, its Mach Boost and using all actions to Dash), allowing it to reach Lycrothemia over roughly 12 days. However, its primary method of reaching Lycrothemia would be to teleport just outside the moon’s sphere of abjurative interference that prevents inward teleportation, leaving it with 18,000 km left (roughly 18 hours of top-speed travel). It is also capable of fully circling Somnus Domina in roughly one day (or half that if it exits the atmosphere first).

**Construct Nature.** The Sword of Damocles doesn’t require food, drink or air.

**Godfall Cannon.** The Sword of Damocles is equipped with a weapon of mass destruction, the godfall cannon. This weapon is the greatest eidomantic resonator in existence, rivaled only by Lycrothemia. If powered by the essence of the Eidolons - the primal gemstones - it can operate on a level that allows for orbital strikes capable of vanquishing entire nations, or destroying minor celestial bodies. The orbital godfall cannon requires a full three months to charge, which is cut in half sequentially for each primal gemstone powering it.

When fired, the godfall cannon can target any point the Sword has a direct line of sight to, and when it strikes it erupts into a controlled explosion that can blast a target of up to 250 square miles (or can be concentrated into a smaller, more intense blast if the Sword wishes to do so). Any creature caught in the blast must succeed a DC 30 Constitution saving throw, taking 325 (50d12) force damage on a failed save.

This cannon is the primary means by which the Sword of Damocles would attempt to destroy its targets, and though it is capable of ripping apart Lycrothemia, it does not possess the power necessary to bypass the restorative magic Vestias placed on that moon unless it has at least 8 primal gemstones.

traits.name: Astral Transmission Drive
traits.description: If the Sword spends at least 1 minute concentrating on doing so, it can open a gate that cuts through the astral sea, emerging in any space the Sword chooses in a plane it is familiar with.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: When the Sword fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Sword attacks twice with its Thesite Claws and once with its Tail Blade.

actions.name: Thesite Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 50 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) force damage.

actions.name: Tail Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 80 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (4d12) slashing damage plus 33 (6d10) force damage.

actions.name: Full-Scale Assault (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The Sword unleashes a barrage of missile blasts and a large burst of energy that targets six points it can see within 10 miles, unleashing a 100-foot-radius sphere at each point. Each creature within those spheres must succeed on a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 91 (14d12) force damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

actions.name: Eidomantic Barrier
actions.description: The Sword becomes resistant to all damage it would take until the start of its next turn, during which time it has advantage on all saving throws it makes.

actions.name: Mach Boost
actions.description: The Sword doubles its movement speed until the start of its next turn, and immediately takes the Dash action.

bonus_actions.name: Singularity Generator (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.description: The Sword generates a gate to the astral sea that intercepts one effect or attack targeting it, reducing the damage from that attack by 100.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The Sword moves up to its movement speed.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.description: The Sword makes a Tail Blade attack.

legendary_actions.name: Force Blast (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The Sword fires a burst of energy from its mouth at a creature within 240 feet, which must succeed on a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw or take 39 (6d12) force damage. A creature who fails this save by 5 points or more is stunned until the start of their next turn.
